snippet.title: Terrifier The ARTcade Game | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎪 Show No Mercy as Art the Clown in Terrifier: The ARTcade Game.

Step into the blood-soaked shoes of Art the Clown and unleash chaos in Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, the over-the-top 2D beat ’em up inspired by the Terrifier universe, is now available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!
With a haunting main theme composed by Cody Carpenter (son of horror legend John Carpenter), this game blends old-school arcade mayhem with cinematic terror. Fight through movie sets inspired by Art’s gruesome legacy, crush enemies with brutal combos, and turn every level into a masterpiece of gore.

Key Features:
- Gorgeous Pixel Art & Animation – Captures the twisted charm of the Terrifier films in vibrant, gory detail.
- Multiplayer Madness: Up to 4-player local co-op with unique modes and challenges.
- Bloody Arsenal: Chainsaws, cleavers, and plenty of creative ways to dismember.
- Epic Boss Battles: Test your skills across multiple movie sets and grotesque foes.
- Retro Chiptune Soundtrack: Dive into pulse-pounding beats that fuel the carnage.
- Over-the-Top Finishers: Brutal, hilarious, and unforgettable attacks.
- Multiple Game Modes: Quick brawls or extended chaos, your choice!

Limited Physical Editions Available Now in Europe and Coming on December 19th in North America.
🎬 Play now and join the bloodbath:

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130400/Terrifier_The_ARTcade_Game/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/terrifier-the-artcade-game-switch/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012787/
Xbox Series: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/terrifier-the-artcade-game/9P27CCK0VT8G
